shared_elements: low-relief carved figural scene on a rectangular field
weapons or long staff-like objects held by figures
justification: Both are low relief with strictly profile human and animal figures organised along horizontal registers, with bearded men holding elongated objects (bow/spear versus staffs) and quadrupeds in profile alongside them, which is a real but broad correspondence in figural convention. The depicted subjects differ sharply: A shows a dynamic hunt/battle with a chariot, drawn bow, galloping horses and collapsing lions, while B shows static, evenly spaced processions of standing attendants and led animals with no action, no chariot and no violence.
